snippet.title: Bermuda Survivor - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at action-packed gameplay and the hordes of enemies you'll fight in this Bermuda Survivor reveal trailer for the upcoming game that blends bullet heaven and world exploration. In Bermuda Survivor, your goal is to survive the hordes of enemies and discover the secrets of the Bermuda Triangle. Each run will provide you with new unlockables, story bits, NPC-related quests, and optimal paths to achieve victory. Bermuda Survivor will be available on PC.
